prompt: 哪一句的倒裝是正確的？
options: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never I have seen such a beautiful sunset.
Never I saw have such a beautiful sunset.
answer: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

wrong.Never I have seen such a beautiful sunse: Never 這類否定副詞放句首時，助動詞要提前到主詞前面，不能保持 I have 的原順序。
wrong.Never I saw have such a beautiful sunset: saw 與 have 同時出現，動詞形式混亂；倒裝只需把助動詞 have 移到 I 前面，後面用 seen。

why: 否定副詞 Never 放句首要強調時，助動詞 have 提到主詞 I 之前，形成 Never have I seen。
tip: 否定詞開頭，助動詞先行，主詞殿後。
say: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的答案。
text: So tired _____ that he fell asleep during the movie.
options: was he
he was
did he

wrong.he was: So + 形容詞放句首時，be 動詞必須移到主詞前面，he was 沒有倒裝。
wrong.did he: 句中原本是 be 動詞 was（tired 是形容詞），不能改用助動詞 did。

why: So tired 在句首，後面的 be 動詞要倒裝成 was he，再接 that 子句表示結果。
tip: So + 形容詞開頭，後面 be 動詞要倒裝。
say: So tired was he that he fell asleep during the movie.

prompt: 哪一句「也不」的用法正確？
options: Tom didn't call me, and neither did Jane.
Tom didn't call me, and neither Jane did.
Tom didn't call me, and Jane did neither.
answer: Tom didn't call me, and neither did Jane.

wrong.Tom didn't call me, and neither Jane did: neither 引導的句子要倒裝，助動詞 did 要放在主詞 Jane 前面。
wrong.Tom didn't call me, and Jane did neither: did neither 的位置不自然，這個意思要用 neither did Jane 或 Jane didn't either。

why: 前句是否定，後面表示「某人也沒有」用 neither + 助動詞 + 主詞。
tip: neither／nor 開頭的句子，助動詞放主詞前。
say: Tom didn't call me, and neither did Jane.

prompt: 朋友說：「我沒有做完功課。」你也沒做完，要怎麼回應？
options: Neither have I.
So have I.
Neither I have.

So have I 表示「我也是（有做）」，朋友說的是否定句，所以不能用 So。
neither 開頭要倒裝，have 要放在 I 前面，不能說 Neither I have。

why: 對否定句表示「我也一樣沒有」，用 Neither + 助動詞 + 主詞；have 對應前句的完成式。
tip: 否定句回應「我也是」用 Neither，肯定句用 So。

text: Not only _____ the exam, but she also won a scholarship.
options: did she pass
she passed
she did pass

wrong.she passed: Not only 放句首時後面要倒裝，she passed 仍是一般語序。
wrong.she did pass: did 要移到主詞 she 前面，變成 did she pass，而不是 she did pass。

why: Not only 放句首時，第一個子句要倒裝；一般動詞過去式要借助 did，動詞回到原形 pass。
tip: Not only 開頭，借助 do／does／did 倒裝。
say: Not only did she pass the exam, but she also won a scholarship.

prompt: 這句話最接近下列哪個意思？
text: Rarely do students finish the whole book in one night.
options: 學生很少在一晚內讀完整本書。
學生經常一晚就讀完整本書。
學生從來沒有讀過整本書。
answer: 學生很少在一晚內讀完整本書。

wrong.學生經常一晚就讀完整本書。: Rarely 是「很少」，意思相反；do students 的倒裝並不改變否定意味。
wrong.學生從來沒有讀過整本書。: Rarely 是「很少」不是「從不」，而且句子說的是一晚內讀完，不是完全沒讀過。

why: Rarely 放句首引起倒裝 do students finish，意思就是「很少」，語意不變，只是更強調。
tip: Rarely 是「很少」，放句首要倒裝。
say: Rarely do students finish the whole book in one night.

prompt: 哪一句的 such 用法正確？
options: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.
Such the noise was that nobody could sleep.
Such was noise that nobody could sleep.
answer: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.

wrong.Such the noise was that nobody could sle: Such 放句首時 be 動詞要提前，應是 Such was the noise，語序不能保持原樣。
noise 前面少了 the，Such was the noise that 才是完整的固定說法。

why: Such + be + 名詞片語 + that 子句，表示「…到…的程度」，be 動詞提前到名詞之前。
tip: Such 開頭時，be 動詞放在名詞片語前。
say: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.

text: Only after the bell rang _____ the classroom.
options: did the students leave
the students left
the students did leave

wrong.the students left: Only after... 放句首時，主要子句要倒裝，不能用一般語序 the students left。
wrong.the students did leave: 助動詞 did 要放在主詞前面，the students did leave 沒有完成倒裝。

why: Only + 時間副詞片語放句首時，主要子句倒裝：did the students leave，動詞用原形。
tip: Only after／only when 開頭，主要子句要倒裝。
say: Only after the bell rang did the students leave the classroom.

prompt: 哪一句不需要倒裝，而且是正確的？
options: She hardly noticed the change.
Hardly she noticed the change.
Hardly noticed she the change.

Hardly 放句首時需要倒裝，Hardly did she notice，這句沒有倒裝所以錯誤。
一般動詞倒裝要借助 did，不能直接把動詞 noticed 放在主詞前面。

why: hardly 放在動詞前面時是一般語序，不需要倒裝；只有放句首才倒裝。
tip: 否定副詞放句中不倒裝，放句首才倒裝。

prompt: 你想說：「我們不但錯過了公車，而且連計程車也叫不到。」哪一句最正確？
options: Not only did we miss the bus, but we couldn't get a taxi either.
Not only we missed the bus, but we couldn't get a taxi either.
Not only missed we the bus, but we couldn't get a taxi either.
answer: Not only did we miss the bus, but we couldn't get a taxi either.

wrong.Not only we missed the bus, but we could: Not only 放句首，第一子句必須倒裝成 did we miss，這裡沒有倒裝。
wrong.Not only missed we the bus, but we could: 一般動詞不能直接移到主詞前，要用 did we miss 的形式。

why: Not only 放句首，借 did 倒裝為 did we miss，後面接 but 子句補充說明。
tip: Not only 句首，did 在主詞前，動詞用原形。
say: Not only did we miss the bus, but we couldn't get a taxi either.

text: So generous was the donor that the school renamed the library after him.
options: 捐款者非常慷慨，所以學校用他的名字命名圖書館。
學校很慷慨，所以捐款者幫圖書館改名。
捐款者不夠慷慨，學校沒有改名。
answer: 捐款者非常慷慨，所以學校用他的名字命名圖書館。

wrong.學校很慷慨，所以捐款者幫圖書館改名。: generous 描述的是 the donor，倒裝只是把形容詞提前，主詞仍是捐款者。
wrong.捐款者不夠慷慨，學校沒有改名。: So generous...that 表示因為非常慷慨才有後果，與「不夠慷慨」相反。

why: So + 形容詞 + be + 主詞 + that 子句，表示「因為太…所以…」，generous 形容的是 the donor。
tip: So + 形容詞…that 是原因，that 後是結果。
say: So generous was the donor that the school renamed the library after him.

text: I don't like spicy food, _____ does my sister.
options: nor
and so
but neither

wrong.and so: and so 後面接肯定意義的倒裝，但前句是否定，應用 nor 或 neither。
wrong.but neither: but 表示轉折，與「我姊姊也不喜歡」的順接語意衝突。

why: 前句 don't like 是否定，nor 後面接倒裝 does my sister，表示「也不」。
tip: nor 帶有否定，後面直接接倒裝。
say: I don't like spicy food, nor does my sister.
